title: Corporate Upgrade Rates for Premium Economy Upgrades
content:
**Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — upgrade terms for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The Premium Economy upgrade price is multiplied by the **corporate upgrade rate**, which follows the agreement the ticket names and the tier's negotiated discount for the ticket's itinerary class. The rate acts on the unrounded price; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

## The discount looked at

| Itinerary class of the ticket | Negotiated discount of the agreement tier |
|---|---|
| Domestic | The domestic discount |
| Short-haul international | The domestic discount |
| Long-haul international | The international discount |

## The rate

| Agreement named on the ticket | Negotiated discount (percent) | Corporate upgrade rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 10 or more (deep discount) | 0.8 |
| Active | At least 1 (some discount) and below 10 | 0.9 |
| Any other ticket | — | 1 |

The agreement's status is read from its record, and the negotiated discounts from its tier's terms, in Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Status | Itinerary class | Domestic discount | International discount | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Long-haul international | 5 | 10 | 0.8 |
| Active | Short-haul international | 5 | 10 | 0.9 |
| Active | Domestic | 0 | 8 | 1 |
| Not active | Long-haul international | 12 | 12 | 1 |
